Services
Expert cybersecurity support.
Anytime, anywhere.
Extend the AI-native protection Darktrace gives you with 24/7 expert support, helping you maximize your investment and navigate your cybersecurity journey effectively
Request a consultation
Organizations today are facing a fast-moving threat landscape, and the consequences of a cyber-attack can be devastating.
Without a sufficient level of in-house expertise, remaining resilient against new and emerging threats is an ongoing challenge.
That’s why we offer a range of managed and expert services.
Our AI-driven products swiftly identify and neutralize threats, while our seasoned analysts provide 24/7 support to maximize your investment.
Whenever you have a problem, need guidance during an investigation, or simply want to talk to an expert, you can rely on us.

Lean on their expertise to help you swiftly respond to critical Darktrace alerts across your environment, giving your team extra support when every second matters
AI-supported expert services
Global security experts, backed by AI
Cyber AI Analyst™
When problem-solving or investigating on your behalf, our analysts leverage the insights and investigative power of Cyber AI Analyst to deeply understand your environment.  Empowered by AI-driven precision, they can help you triage and prioritize the highest-priority threats and guide you in the best course of action.
Experts in Darktrace
Benefit from our experts’ advanced product knowledge and wealth of threat hunting experience to help you bridge the cybersecurity skills gap.   Whether it's threat notification, optimization, or enhancing your security posture, the dedicated Darktrace team is always ready to assist.
Our services
Our comprehensive services include seamless integration, tailored solutions, and proactive threat management.  Working alongside your team, our experts enhance your security posture so you’re free to focus on long-term threat eradication.
Wrap-around expert support
Darktrace Managed Detection & Response™
Let our expert analysts tirelessly monitor and investigate your alerts, to help you detect and respond to threats across network, cloud, SaaS, and OT – giving you unparalleled security and business resilience.
